title: Gyrolly
tagline: Gyrolly is a DePIN project which enables physical movement to be counted on mobile application...
description:
Gyrolly is a DePIN project 
This project is built on mobile platform with objective to convey tactical and mobile experience to users.
This project uses Dynamic SDK behind the scenes to connect wallets to users. Also supports Flow and Mantle chain.
Technical stacks include react-native, typescript, node-js and arduino.
